speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe exactly what happened right before you lost consciousness, and did you experience any warning signs like dizziness or chest pain?

speaker: Patient
text: I was just finishing urinating when I suddenly passed out without any warning signs like dizziness or chest pain. speaker: Doctor
text: That sounds like a classic case of micturition syncope, which is a type of reflex syncope triggered by urination. DIAGNOSIS READY: Micturition Syncope
